records.body:

draft.subject: Quick help getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Following up on our onboarding call last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through the first project with you and answer anything that came up since we spoke.

Best,
Chidi
